channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Former Kilkenny captain 'disgusted' with performance in Salthill
item.description: Andy Comerford has ripped into Kilkenny's underperforming stars in the wake of last Saturday's hammering by Galway.

item.title: Donegal v Down confirmed for Letterkenny
item.description: O'Donnell Park has been confirmed as the venue for Donegal's Ulster SFC quarter-final against Down next month.

item.title: Brennan departs Tyrone squad
item.description: Tyrone have been dealt a major blow with the news that Rory Brennan has opted out of the squad for the remainder of the season.

item.title: Keegan: Kerry game a 'free hit' for Mayo
item.description: Lee Keegan believes the pressure is off Mayo ahead of their trip to Tralee to face Kerry on Saturday evening.

item.title: Durnin starts for Louth against Derry
item.description: Tommy Durnin will make his first start of the season for Louth against Derry in Ardee on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Not all heroes wear capes: Dublin's inspirational Emma O'Byrne
item.description: Emma O'Byrne is a Dublin senior camogie player of long standing, eight years on from her introduction to the life as an elite sportsperson by David Herity.

item.title: McDonald and Beirne committed to Mayo U20s
item.description: Keith Higgins has confirmed that senior panellists Kobe McDonald and Darragh Beirne will be available for Mayo's Connacht U20FC opener against Sligo next Wednesday evening in Tubbercurry.

item.title: Legendary Offaly hurler remembered on anniversary
item.description: It's 40 years since legendary Coolderry and Offaly hurler Pat Carroll passed away after a short illness at the age of just 30.

item.title: Donegal club thrilled to host first Ulster SFC game in 75 years
item.description: St Eunan's GAA club in Letterkenny has expressed delight at confirmation that it will host next month's Ulster SFC quarter-final between Donegal and Down.

item.title: O'Callaghan still absent as Dublin and Armagh announce teams
item.description: Dublin and Armagh have named their teams for tomorrow evening's Allianz Football League Division 1 encounter at Croke Park.
